T: Cash, a mall, and a very good plan.
D: A flight attendant caught smuggling money plays the cops and a gun runner against each other.
P: Serve the snacks when the money swap happens at the shopping mall.
S: Del Amo food court teriyaki skewers
the half-million-dollar switch at the Del Amo mall

Chicken thigh glazed in sticky soy, ginger and mirin teriyaki, charred on skewers, with sesame, spring onion and pickled cucumber in paper food court boats. Simmer 80ml soy, 80ml mirin, 2 tbsp brown sugar and grated ginger for 4 minutes until syrupy. Thread 800g diced chicken thighs onto 12 skewers. Grill on high for 10 minutes, turning and brushing with the glaze in the last 4 minutes until sticky and charred. Slice a cucumber thin and toss with 2 tbsp rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar. Serve in paper boats with sesame seeds and spring onion.
Lager battered fish strips in corn tortillas with cabbage and chipotle crema
White fish in a light beer batter fried at 180C, in warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, chipotle crema and lime.
Roasted peanuts with lime zest, chili and flaky salt, in little foil packets
Peanuts tossed in lime zest, chilli powder and salt, roasted at 160C for 15 minutes, served in little foil packets like on the plane.
M: Seared sirloin, loaded baked potato and iceberg wedge with blue cheese dressing
Sirloin seared hard, pulled at 54C, rested, with a baked potato loaded with sour cream and chives and a wedge salad with blue cheese.
Ordell's South Bay hot honey fried chicken

Buttermilk-brined chicken fried shatter-crisp, drizzled with chilli hot honey, with smoky braised greens and a creamy baked mac and cheese. Brine 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tbsp hot sauce. Dredge in 300g flour with 2 tsp paprika and fry at 165C until 74C inside. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes and drizzle over. Wilt 2 bunches kale with bacon and cider vinegar. Toss 300g cooked macaroni with 200g grated cheddar, 250ml milk and 1 egg and bake at 180C for 30 minutes.
W: Moist banana loaf studded with walnuts

Moist brown sugar banana bread studded with walnuts, toasted in thick slices and spread with salted maple butter. Mash 3 ripe bananas with 120g melted butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs and vanilla. Fold in 250g self-raising flour and 80g walnuts and bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 55 minutes. Beat 40g soft butter with 1 tbsp maple syrup and a pinch of salt. Toast thick slices and spread with the maple butter.
K: Vodka, blood orange and orange juice with ginger syrup over ice

Vodka over ice with fresh blood orange and orange juice, a dash of ginger syrup for bite, and a blood orange wheel on the rim. Simmer 50g sugar, 50ml water and a sliced 3cm piece of ginger for 5 minutes and cool. Squeeze 4 blood oranges and 2 oranges. For each drink, fill a tall glass with ice, add 45ml vodka and 10ml ginger syrup and top with about 150ml of the mixed juice. Stir and add a blood orange wheel.
